findings.note: Rush filed S.318, 'An Act requiring voters to furnish identification'. Text adds to G.L. c.50 a Section 9: 'All persons voting at a primary or election shall produce valid proof of their identity before so voting.' It lists no accepted documents and no fallback for voters without ID. Referred to Election Laws, hearing scheduled 2011-09-21, and later accompanied a study order (S2364). Docket notes it is similar to House 670 of 2009-2010.
Rush (then a House member) was the sponsor of H.670, 'An Act Requiring Voters To Furnish Identification'. It was referred to committee and accompanied a study order. I did not read the bill text.
